_description: Facebook link carousel: 2 to 10 images, each a card that links out. facebookCarouselMainLink is the post's link and the destination of any card without its own mediaLink. Images only; with one image the post is a normal photo post.

posts.content: Two new guides are up. Swipe to pick one.

_notes: mediaCaption is the card's headline (keep it to 32 characters), mediaDescription the line under it (keep it to 18 characters)
facebookCarouselShowEndCard adds Facebook's end card after the last card; it is off by default
